title: Annual Membership (Raku Access)
cost_text: $120 (with locker) or $60 (no locker); $60 or $30 if joining Oct 1 or after
evidence_quote: Access to specialty clay and luster firings, Raku firings (when available)
evidence_sentence: Members receive access to raku firings when available as a core membership benefit.
how_to_join: Complete at least one 8-week class, then purchase an annual membership
pay_text: $120/year with locker or $60/year without; half price if joining Oct 1 or after
source_quote: Annual memberships will now run on a new schedule, from April 1- March 31 each year... Access to specialty clay and luster firings, Raku firings (when available)
summary: Spokane Potters' Guild annual membership ($60–$120/year) includes access to raku firings when available, open studio time, and board participation. Membership requires completing at least one 8-week class and volunteer participation.
